purpose: Canonical per-character identity + wardrobe locks and Drive reference file IDs. This registry is what guarantees Bella / Ciao / friends look identical across every Higgsfield start/end frame. Shared DNA, Shared Negatives and colour grade live in characters/shared.md.

stale_data_corrections.note: Do not reintroduce. character_voices.json says Ha-eun 'Los Angeles' (actually NYC) and Mei 'Sydney' (actually Melbourne); friends_db.json city values below are canonical. No *_close_face.png crops exist for any character — identity locks rely on the listed _reference.png files only.
stale_data_corrections.bella_resolved: NO freckles. Default expression = soft half-smile at rest (eyes smile before mouth); full open-mouth smile is EARNED only (laugh / Ciao / a friend's win). Canonical reference = all three on-disk refs below.

higgsfield_identity_note: Higgsfield has no @tag mechanism. Per character: train a Higgsfield custom reference (Soul character) from refs.* and record the UUID in refs.higgsfieldCustomReferenceId. Until trained, pass the Drive-exported public URL of the primary _reference.png via image_reference_image_url. custom_reference_strength / style_strength defaults live in config/defaults.json.

bella.identity_lock: 25, Italian-American (Italian father, Irish mother), NYC-born, Melbourne home base, London third. Dark-brown hair centre-parted, long & loosely waved, SUBTLE warm highlights (NOT blonde, NOT heavy balayage), flyaway at temple. Bright clear cornflower-BLUE eyes with darker iris ring (NOT hazel/green/brown/grey). Warm olive skin, visible pores, slight asymmetry. NO FRECKLES. Small subtle gold hoop earrings (NOT studs). Default: relaxed face, soft half-smile at rest, eyes smiling before mouth; full open-mouth smile EARNED only. Hair states: down=relaxed, half-up/low-bun=working, twisted knot=about-to-act. Makeup 80% light-natural / 20% bare.
bella.camera_address_mandate: Bella always looks directly into the lens, eyes locked, head square to camera. Off-camera/averted gaze = hard re-roll.
bella.wardrobe: NY-London editorial, vintage-mixed, neutral, never logoed/expensive. Rotation: vintage straight-leg jeans, white linen shirt or Breton, oversized knit, worn black blazer, vintage leather jacket, Doc Martens/boots/plain sneakers, canvas tote/leather crossbody, delicate gold jewellery, apron when working. Default close-up wardrobe: navy V-neck knit.

ciao.identity_lock: SMALL compact smooth-coat Italian Greyhound — NOT tall/long-legged, NOT whippet, NOT terrier, NOT wire-haired, NOT oversized.
